paper_question: When a target analyte is observed in source HUC6 basins but a target HUC6 basin is sparse, can shared ecology-time information reconstruct the analyte and how much do K local observations add?
reason_for_new_version: The target-unseen-analyte K=0 route has no legal native-unit output scale. This route keeps the target analyte visible in source HUC6 basins and holds out the target HUC6 basin.
prior_exposure: Stage-2A same-analyte outputs were observed before protocol correction. They remain descriptive diagnostics and do not count as v2 transfer evidence.
anti_switching_clause: These endpoints are frozen before v2 transfer training. Any change requires a new version with a written reason; v1 remains immutable.

primary_task.query_component: frozen largest component rows from the task manifest

visibility.source_target_analyte_labels: visible for source fit, source validation, native-unit output scaling, and source-only model selection
visibility.target_huc6_outcome_labels: hidden from fit, early stopping, normalization, threshold selection, and model selection
visibility.target_support: only K target-analyte support cells are visible during adaptation
visibility.target_covariates: frozen ecological, hydroclimatic, temporal, and graph inputs are allowed; target-HUC6 outcome labels for other analytes remain hidden

external_selection.rule: availability and provenance only before model results are inspected
external_selection.role: future independent replication; no tuning or endpoint changes

primary: paired Delta-MAE at K=5 versus the source-only-selected strongest simple baseline
relative MAE reduction for the same comparison
support value-shuffle and support site-shuffle gaps

aggregation.cross_analyte_raw_mae: not pooled because native units differ
aggregation.bootstrap: calendar month clusters with HUC6 fixed strata and paired methods/K values

feasibility_gate.basin_consistency: same direction in >=3/5 target HUC6 tasks
feasibility_gate.k_curve: K=5 no worse than K=0 and K=1 for the primary aggregate
feasibility_gate.support_integrity: true support beats both value-shuffle and site-shuffle
feasibility_gate.no_harm: no primary analyte/HUC6 cell worsens by >5% while pooled success is claimed

confirmation.external: DOC and at least one secondary analyte same direction with at least one replicated analyte CI excluding zero; no retuning

uncertainty.ranking_unlock: requires at least two independent tools or indicators; otherwise no blind-spot or active-sampling claim

fallback: If the v2 internal transfer gate fails, retain the current DOC reconstruction and empirical uncertainty route as the manuscript mainline and report transfer as a bounded negative or exploratory result.
